name: Osprey Atlas
tagline: Every roofline, tower, and turbine — surveyed from above, understood on the ground.
positioning: Osprey Atlas turns your consumer drone into a professional inspection instrument, generating structured reports from a single guided flight.

hero.h1: See your property the way the sky sees it.
hero.sub: Osprey Atlas guides a single automated flight, then hands you a surveyor-grade inspection report — cracked flashing, corroded mounts, blocked gutters, all pinpointed and priced.

features.title: Guided flight, hands off
features.description: Draw a boundary on the map and Osprey Atlas plans the orbit, altitude, and overlap for you. Your drone flies the pattern; you just watch it work.

features.title: Findings, not just footage
features.description: Instead of 400 raw photos, you receive an annotated report: each defect flagged, measured, and mapped to a spot on your 3D model.

features.title: The report your insurer wants
features.description: Export a timestamped, geotagged PDF that adjusters, roofers, and HOAs actually accept — no professional license required.

features.title: Change over time
features.description: Re-fly the same route each season and Osprey Atlas overlays the results, so you catch the hairline crack before it becomes a claim.

features.title: Works with your drone
features.description: Compatible with the mainstream consumer platforms you already own. No proprietary hardware, no dealer, no runway.

features.title: Yours, kept private
features.description: Flights and models stay in your personal vault. Share a single read-only link when you choose, revoke it when you're done.

testimonials.quote: I inspected a chimney I hadn't safely reached in nine years. The report caught a spalling course of brick and gave me photos my mason trusted. Osprey Atlas paid for itself before lunch.
testimonials.name: Daniel Reyes

testimonials.quote: We manage twelve small commercial roofs. Sending someone up a ladder for each was a liability nightmare. Now one person flies the whole portfolio in a morning and the findings land in my inbox.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

testimonials.quote: As a solo home inspector, this quietly upgraded my entire offering. Clients see the orbital model and think I brought a crew. It's just me and Osprey Atlas.
testimonials.name: Marcus Boyd

pricing.blurb: For the curious homeowner surveying one property a season.
For prosumers and hands-on managers watching several structures.
For serious independents inspecting portfolios professionally.

homepage.footerBlurb: Osprey Atlas gives every individual the vantage once reserved for survey crews. One flight, one report, the whole picture.
